title: Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: A classic Uruguayan dish filled with savory beef, perfect for a quick dinner or snack. Serve with a side of chimichurri sauce for added flavor.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef mixture and beaten egg. Mix well to combine.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the remaining dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough. You should be able to get about 8-10 circles.
Place a tablespoon or two of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water, and then sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
